grammarFocus: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing 的常见用法；基础被动语态入门。
title: The Smart Water Bottle
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是关于一个智能水瓶的模拟教育材料，不是真实的新闻或产品。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。
passage: A small company in Shenzhen made a smart water bottle. It helps people drink enough water every day. The bottle has a small screen. The screen shows the time and the water temperature. It also reminds you to drink water. When you need to drink, the bottle makes a sound and a light. The light is blue. You can turn off the sound if you want. The bottle is made of glass and plastic. It is easy to clean. You can put it in the dishwasher. The bottle has a battery. The battery lasts for one week. You charge it with a USB cable. The bottle is not expensive. It costs 200 yuan. Many people like it because it is useful. You can buy it online or in stores. The company says the bottle is good for your health. But some people think it is not necessary. They say you can just drink water when you are thirsty. The company wants to help people build good habits. They are making a new version with a bigger screen. The new version will also have a game. The game can remind you to drink. The company plans to sell it next year. The new bottle will be sold in many countries. The company hopes people will use it to stay healthy. They also want to make a smaller bottle for children. The children's bottle will be light and easy to carry. It will have a funny face on the screen. The face will smile when a child drinks water. The company says the children's bottle will cost 120 yuan. It will be sold in schools and shops near schools. Many parents are interested in it. They want their children to drink more water. The company will show the new bottles at a big meeting in June. People can try them there. The company will also answer questions about the bottles.

grammar.title: 表目的 to do；动词后接 to do / doing；基础被动语态
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，表示目的常用“to + 动词原形”，例如“I drink water to stay healthy.”。有些动词后面常接“to do”，如want, need, plan, decide等；有些动词后面常接“doing”，如like, enjoy, finish等。被动语态表示“被……”，基本结构是“be + 过去分词”，例如“The bottle is made of glass.”。
grammar.example: It helps people drink enough water every day.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence to show purpose:
options: I drink water to stay healthy.
I drink water for stay healthy.
answers: I drink water to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: 表示目的用“to + 动词原形”，所以A正确。

options: She wants to buy a new phone.
She wants buying a new phone.
She wants buy a new phone.
She want to buy a new phone.
answers: She wants to buy a new phone.
questions.explanation: want后面接to do，且主语she是第三人称单数，动词要加s，所以A正确。

options: The bottle is made of glass.
The bottle is make of glass.
answers: The bottle is made of glass.
questions.explanation: 被动语态结构是be + 过去分词，make的过去分词是made，所以A正确。
